messages:
Claire Wong: Quick UX spike 1: in the batch vectors preview users keep asking why CSV exports include hidden columns. Expected behaviour: export should match visible columns by default.
Ben Harris: Agree. Suggestion: add a small toggle next to Export: "Export visible columns only" (ON by default). If OFF, show a warning: "This may include large fields like full embeddings."
Mina Rao: Accessibility note: when the export modal opens keyboard focus goes to the modal title instead of the first control. Need to set focus to the first actionable element and trap focus. Also ensure aria-live updates for export job status.
Theo Jensen: Backend constraints: large exports (>50k rows or include embeddings) must use queued job API. Plan: POST /exports returns job_id. Client polls /exports/:job_id and shows progress. For tiny exports (<2k) we can stream in-browser.
Claire Wong: Copy thought: change primary CTA from "Export" to "Export results" and helper text under the toggle: "Defaults to columns visible in the preview. Uncheck to include all dataset fields."
Ben Harris: Add a preview sample inside the modal: "Preview first 3 rows" link that renders a tiny table. Helps avoid surprises and clarifies column mapping.
Mina Rao: Also the mapping selects need descriptive labels and example values (e.g., owner: team-a) for screen readers. Use aria-describedby to link to examples.
Theo Jensen: File formats: present three radio options: CSV (metadata + preview text), CSV+embeddings (base64), ZIP (CSV + .npy). Default to CSV. If user picks CSV+embeddings and rows>1k, show an estimated size and force job queue.
Claire Wong: UX microcopy: include a short line in the preview header: "Exports respect current sort & filters." and a small info icon with tooltip.
Ben Harris: Also have an advanced link: "Save mapping" so frequent exporters can reuse column sets. Mappings should be manageable in Settings > Export mappings.
Mina Rao: A11y detail: when queued job completes and download link appears, announce "Export ready" via live region and move focus to the download CTA. Keyboard users should be able to retrieve the pre-signed URL from a notifications panel too.
Theo Jensen: Implementation note: include filter_hash and sort_state in the export payload for reproducibility. Add audit log entry with export_id, user_id, filter_hash.
Claire Wong: Small UI debate: should we show vectors size (MB) inline? I think yes, when embeddings included show estimated total size and a small progress hint.
Ben Harris: For the column header names in CSV, use stable keys: preview_text, rerank_score, metadata.*. But show friendly mapping in the modal.
Mina Rao: Also ensure color-only badges have text equivalents. Rerank score badges should include aria-label like "Rerank score: 0.74, higher is more relevant".
export-bot: Created design ticket DX-4310 "Export behavior: visible columns, queued jobs, and accessibility" (assignee: Claire Wong). :spiral_note_pad:
Theo Jensen: I'll open an engineering spike for the job API and include streaming fallback. Marking edge cases where user cancels job mid-run.
Claire Wong: I'll update the Figma with the toggle, mapping preview, and copy updates by EOD and attach acceptance criteria. Thanks for the rapid feedback!
